caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of beadwork measuring approximately 7 inches by 2 inches. The beadwork is bordered by a light-colored outline. Within the border, the design features a central horizontal band dominated by a repeating pattern of circular, spiral, and swirl motifs created with white and light blue beads, interspersed with darker blue and black backgrounds. Above and below this central band, there are lattice-like diamond patterns formed with white beads over a dark blue or black background. The overall color scheme includes shades of blue, black, white, and some light accents, with the beadwork pattern presented in a detailed and finely executed manner. The drawing is labeled below with handwritten text identifying the beadwork as a piece from the Delaware Eastern Woodlands, drawn by Melita Hofmann on December 2, 1935.
title: Beadwork
